main_text.p: V. Circuli, quos oportet in Sphæra mundi, hoc est, tum in cœlo, tum in terra imaginari, sunt numero octo. Ex his sunt quatuor maiores, qui mundum diuidunt in duas partes æquales; vt horizon, 5 meridianus, æquator, & Zodiacus: & totidem minores, qui mundum diuidunt in duas partes inæquales; vt tropicus cancri & capricorni, polaris arcticus & antarcticus. Quod attinet ad duos coluros, vnum solstitiorum, alterum æqui noctiorum, illi locum duntaxat habent in cœ-10lo. Ex his circulis horiζon visibilem cœli & terræ partem ab inuisibili dirimit: meridianus inter ortum & occasum est medius, ita vt respondeat puncto verticali: æquator inter duos mundi polos, siue inter septentrionem & meridiem, est medius: Zodiacus obliquè secat æquatorem, 15 duosque tropicos attingit: tropicus cancri in superiori, capricorni, in inferiori parte Zodiacum contingit: polaris arcticus circuit polum superiorem, antarcticus, inferiorem.

Hos circulos oportet partim mente concipere, partim delineare. Mente concipiendi sunt partim in cœlo & in 20 terra, partim in museo, partim in compasso, partim denique in solario. Delineandi sunt in globo cœlesti & terrestri, in Sphæra pertusa siue armillari, in mappis siue tabulis geographicis tum vniuersalibus, tum particularibus; denique in compasso & solario maioribus. 25

I. Vranoscopia sacra complectitur duas so-lum partes: videlicet Sphæricam, & Cō-putum. Nihil enim ex sacris potest colligi, quod illu-stret Theoriam planetarum, & Astrologiam, quæ sunt 35 duæ reliquæ partes Vranoscopiæ.

page.notes: The Greek zeta in "horiζon" is printed as a Greek letter in the Latin word; kept as printed. The punctum sign after "puncto" is a small circle, transcribed as the word "puncto". The text is cut off at the bottom, so the second paragraph ends at "Sphæ-" on this part. The page number is printed as "3" followed by a mark that could be a damaged "0"; it is read as 30 with [?]. The marginal number beside "quæ sunt" is read as 35 and is uncertain. The "I." and "II." are numbered paragraph openings and are kept as text.
